title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 23 in B major

character.text: Two-subject fugue joining an old ricercar-like subject in minims to a galant one

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 8–9), with the tenor's line in the soprano, the bass's line in the alto, at the same pitch level. Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From F♯ major to B major

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and the opening of countersubject 2, inverted. Alto: a figure from countersubject 2 and the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 2. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B major to F♯ major

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 2 (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 2 and the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of countersubject 2 and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: From F♯ major to B major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 13) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Alto: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted and the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 2. Bass: the opening of countersubject 2 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 2.
sections.leads: From B major to F♯ major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 2. Alto: the opening of countersubject 2 (2 times).
sections.leads: From F♯ major to G♯ minor

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G♯ minor to E major

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 2, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: From E major to G♯ minor; perfect cadence in E major at bar 60

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every two bars. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a third every bar. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1 (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every two bars.
sections.leads: From G♯ minor to B major

sections.label: Episode 9
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 2 and the opening of countersubject 2, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted (2 times). Bass: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From B major to F♯ major

sections.label: Episode 10
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 13) in part, with alto and tenor exchanged, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From F♯ major to B major

sections.label: Episode 11
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 2, inverted. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times).
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in B major at bar 104

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1. Returns in the codetta (bar 13). Returns in Episode 1 (bars 17–18).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 8–9) in part, with the tenor's line in the alto, the bass's line in the tenor, transposed. Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 38–41). Returns in Episode 10 (bars 88–92).
